dish.title: Smoky Lentil Sweet Potato Stew
dish.name: Smoky Lentil Sweet Potato Stew
dish.description: Red lentils and sweet potato in a smoky tomato broth, with onion and garlic sweated first.

recipe_version.title: Smoky Lentil Sweet Potato Stew
recipe_version.description: Red lentils and sweet potato in a smoky tomato broth, with onion and garlic sweated first.
recipe_version.doneness: Sweet potato tender, lentils broken down, stew thick enough to hold a spoon.

ingredients.name: sweet potato
ingredients.note: About 8 oz each, cut into 3/4-inch cubes.

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.note: To sweat the onion and bloom the paprika.

ingredients.name: Diamond Crystal kosher salt
ingredients.note: With the onion. If the broth is already salty, start with 2 g and taste the finished stew. 4 g Diamond Crystal kosher salt (1.5 tsp). The same weight is 0.75 tsp Morton coarse kosher salt or 0.75 tsp table salt. UC ANR publication 390575 (November 2023): Diamond Crystal kosher salt 2.8 g per teaspoon, Morton coarse kosher salt 4.8 g per teaspoon, table salt 6 g per teaspoon.

steps.title: Sweat and bloom
steps.body: Cook the yellow onion in the olive oil with the Diamond Crystal kosher salt over medium heat until soft, about 6 minutes. Add the garlic and smoked paprika and cook 1 minute.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.body: Add the red lentils, sweet potato, diced tomatoes, vegetable broth, and black pepper. Simmer 25 minutes, until the sweet potato is tender and the lentils have broken down. Taste the stew and add salt only if the broth did not already season it.

steps.title: Thicken and serve
steps.body: Mash a portion of the stew against the side of the pot until it thickens. Leave some sweet potato cubes visible.
